description: Hashtags for a network, best first, ranked by how the account's own posts with each did against its usual views, then competitors' on the same network, plus its default hashtags. Each says why. Use it before writing hashtags into a caption.

platform.description: The network; empty (a draft with no accounts chosen yet) returns no suggestions

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
